title: Make a small result table
summary: T-SQL: Make a small result table. Add (4).
introduction: VALUES can create rows for a query. An alias names the tiny table and its column.
learningObjectives: Make a small result table with T-SQL

blocks.text: Connect to a practice SQL Server database with SSMS or sqlcmd. Run one example at a time. Results below show cell values or PRINT text without grid headers.

blocks.title: Make a small result table
blocks.code: SELECT n FROM (VALUES (3), (1), (2)) AS numbers(n) ORDER BY n;

blocks.text: VALUES creates rows 3, 1 and 2. ORDER BY sorts them into 1, 2 and 3.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use ORDER BY when the row order matters.
